name: link-firehose-small-payload-udp
description: link-firehose-small-payload's exact traffic profile carried over UDP datagrams instead of a TCP stream - same loopback device, no connection, no stream framing, no ack clock. The delta against link-firehose-small-payload is the TCP protocol cost; everything above the wire is identical.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts; UDP may drop under pressure, so timeouts are the loss signal rather than a defect
